1946, October
The following is a faithful transcription of Retreat Notes, October 13 - 18, by the servant of God Father Solanus Casey OFM Cap. ( found in NOTEBOOK NO. 10 Pages 69 and 70)
RETREAT 1946 ST. FELIX
Oct 13 - 18 % Fr. Wo. - Pittsburgh
Introduction - PURPOSE of Retreat - to check up on oneself spiritually
I Conference
To the O Lord have lifted up my soul
Psalm 24. 1 2 In theeO my God I put my trust let me not be ashamed.
II was late for it
III Con.
Bl. are the poor in spirit for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven even here.
IV Con.
"Create a clean heart in me O Lord!and renew a right spirit within my bowels, - my vitals.
Tuesday
I Con.
Obedience - Let Every soul be subject to Authority.
II "Behold how good and how pleasant it is for breathren to dwell together in unity" (Psalm 132)
III Piety
Wednesday I 1
MORTIFICATION
"I chastize my body and bring it into subjection, Lest having preached I myself become a cast-away.
